title: TwofaFlow::refetch mark is taken before the refetch is sent and lost when the send fails
trigger: Cancel a 2FA reset or finish a login-email step while the connection is closing or the chats path is inactive, so refresh_password_state returns Err
effect: The cached password state stays out of date (old pending reset date, old login email) until something else refetches it; the refetch mark is gone (mem::take then `let _ =`, connect/core/mod.rs:632)
fix: keep the mark until refresh_password_state is sent (or a PasswordFlight::InFlight request holds it); clear it on that request's answer

title: ReviewStage::Reviewing counts answers with `waiting: usize` and matches them by session id, not by the RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Press 'No, it's not me' with several unconfirmed sessions and lose one continuation (request dropped, account generation changes) without an error answer
effect: waiting never reaches 0: the alert stays busy and its buttons stay disabled until restart
fix: Reviewing { requests: Vec<(RequestId, UnconfirmedEntry)> } where each answer or error removes its own request and a lost request is an error

title: AccountNotices::unconfirmed, unconfirmed_count and unconfirmed_entries are three fields that must change together
trigger: updateUnconfirmedSession with count 0, a review that finishes, a getActiveSessions answer
effect: None today; each writer (apply_unconfirmed_session, resolve_unconfirmed_entries, finish_login_review) clears or fills them by hand, so a new writer can leave a count with no entries (alert with no buttons)
fix: one `Unconfirmed { first, count, entries: Fetch<Vec<UnconfirmedEntry>> }` value replaced whole

title: TwofaFlow keeps code_wait, notice and refetch as separate one-shot slots cleared by hand from the UI
trigger: A reset result lands while the two-step dialog is closed, or the dialog moves view without going through goto_twofa_view
effect: A stale notice line ('Two-step verification was disabled') shows on the next open; clear_twofa_flow and goto_twofa_view are the only clearers (ui/security/mod.rs:616-620)
fix: one TwofaFlow stage enum owned by the dialog (CodeWait/Notice as variants) cleared when the dialog closes

title: baseline: CallSummary::busy is a stored bool derived from the terminal update
trigger: An outgoing call declined before it connected
effect: None today; busy is computed once in from_terminal and copied through the summary clones
fix: derive it from end reason: CallSummary::end: CallEnd::{Ended, Declined, Failed} and compute busy() from it

title: ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused is a sub-stage of GroupScreenShare::Sharing kept in step by hand at five sites
trigger: Stop a screen share while paused, or fail startGroupCallScreenSharing, then share again
effect: None today because call_screen.rs:561/691, controls.rs:56 and screen_chooser.rs:596 each reset the bool; a missed reset shows the new share as paused
fix: GroupScreenShare::Sharing { paused: bool } (or Sharing/Paused variants) so Off and Starting cannot be paused

title: ActiveGroupCall::is_my_video_enabled and is_my_video_paused are two bools for one tri-state (off, on, paused)
trigger: Pause the camera, then turn it off
effect: None today; the pair can say paused while disabled
fix: enum MyVideo { Off, On, Paused }

title: ActiveGroupCall::rtmp_url and rtmp_stream_key are two Options written together by one answer
trigger: getVideoChatRtmpUrl answer, replaceVideoChatRtmpUrl answer
effect: None today; apply.rs:160-161 writes both, a future writer of one leaves a url without its key
fix: Option<RtmpInfo { url, key }> (the type rtmp_start already has)

title: ActiveCall::state, ready and transport (and CallProgress::HangingUp) are separate fields that must agree
trigger: discardCall fails after the call went to HangingUp: error.rs:61-66 sets call.state = hang_up.resume by hand while calls.progress is reset in another field
effect: None today; ready is Some only for a call created in state Ready (fresh) or set by accept_call_update, and HangingUp lives in both ActiveCall::state and CallProgress, so one can be left behind
fix: one ActiveCall stage enum (Ringing, Exchanging, Ready { ready, transport }, HangingUp(HangUp)) so progress is not a second copy

title: ChatSummary::last_preview, last_preview_style, last_preview_sender, last_preview_thumb and last_message are five fields set 'wherever last_preview is set'
trigger: updateChatLastMessage with an unreadable message, a deleted last message, a draft change, a new chat with last_message
effect: None today; a writer that sets last_preview and misses the style or thumb draws the new text with the old media icon or sender
fix: one LastPreview struct built by one constructor from the message and stored as Option<LastPreview>

title: LinkPreviewFetch::Asked holds no RequestId, so a request whose answer never comes leaves the chip on 'Getting link info'
trigger: Type a URL, then the getLinkPreview request is dropped (connection closes, generation change) without an error answer
effect: The composer chip says 'Getting link info' for that URL for the session; an Asked entry is never evicted or retried, answers are matched by URL text
fix: Asked(RequestId) and settle it on the answer or on a lost-request error; forget_failed also forgets a lost Asked

title: ComposerReplyFetch::Loading holds an attempt count but no RequestId; answers are matched by (chat, message) key
trigger: Reply bar fetch is re-asked (Failed then Loading) while the older request still answers
effect: The older answer fills the entry meant for the newer request, or a dropped request leaves Loading with no way out (composer_reply_fetch_wanted is false for Loading)
fix: Loading { request: RequestId, attempts } and answer only the held request

title: Inline query answers are matched by (chat, bot) and the Loading stage, not by the request that asked
trigger: Type @bot query1, then edit to query2 quickly: both getInlineQueryResults go out, the slot is Loading for query2, query1's answer arrives first
effect: The picker shows query1's results as the result of query2 (the code's own `ponytail` comment admits it); the slot's InlineQueryFetch::Loading holds no RequestId (session_apply_queries.rs:26)
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading(RequestId); apply only the answer whose id the slot holds

title: Login-URL answers are matched by purpose only: last_login_url_info and login_url_request are two Options not tied to a request
trigger: Press a login-URL button, press another one (or press twice) before the first getLoginUrlInfo answers
effect: The first answer lands as the answer of the second press; an error of either takes the other's login_url_request (error.rs:208) and degrades the wrong button to its fallback URL
fix: one LoginUrlStage { Idle, Asking { request: RequestId, ctx }, Answered(info) } and match answers by RequestId

title: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading has no RequestId; a failure removes the entry by bot id
trigger: Open a bot profile, close and reopen it so a second getBotSimilarBots goes out while the first is in flight, then the first fails
effect: The Loading entry of the second request is removed by the first's error and a stray answer can land on an entry that no longer waits
fix: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading(RequestId)

title: A failed getUser for a group bot is never retried: asked_bot_users marks the bot as asked and bots/error.rs has no arm for GroupBotUser
trigger: Open a group whose bot_commands name a bot that is not cached while offline for that one request, or TDLib answers an error
effect: The bot is left out of the '/' menu of the group for the rest of the session (command_bot returns None so group_command_rows filters it)
fix: HashMap<bot id, Fetch<()>> where Failed is retried on the next open and the error arm settles it

title: The logout stage is spread over AuthState::logout_request, AuthState::logout_refused and Session::shutdown
trigger: logOut is refused by TDLib while auth is not Ready, or a quit is requested meanwhile (auth/error.rs:22-32)
effect: None today; the refusal only resets shutdown when auth is Ready, so a refusal in another auth state clears logout_request but leaves shutdown at CloseRequested
fix: one LogoutStage { Idle, Requested(RequestId), Refused(TdError) } inside ShutdownPhase

title: CallsState::call_link and call_link_stage are two fields for one call-link flow
trigger: A call link arrives while a call is on, the user leaves the call, the getGroupCall fails (error.rs:323-331 clears call_link only)
effect: None today; the stage can be Idle while call_link still holds a hash that a later join would send
fix: fold PendingCallLink into CallLinkStage variants

title: recent_calls, recent_calls_offset and recent_calls_stage are three fields for one paged list
trigger: Reopen the Calls tab after a failed page, or Clear all while a page is in flight
effect: None today; the offset has to be reset by hand with the list (the empty offset restarts it) so a reset that misses it appends a page to an old cursor
fix: Paged<ParsedMessage> with its PageStage (src/state/paged.rs)

title: A failed folder loadChats page (anything but 404) ends folder paging with no retry stage and no error
trigger: Select a folder tab with many chats and have the second loadChats page fail with a timeout or 500
effect: The tab keeps a partial list for the session: folder paging continues only from an ok (core/mod.rs:728) or re-selecting the tab; main and archive lists retry through ListPaging::Retrying but folders only have folder_chats_exhausted
fix: HashMap<folder id, ListPaging> so a folder fails into Retrying like the main list

title: Add-chat request pages are matched by community id and purpose, and Fetch::Loading is stored with request: None
trigger: Open the requests list, press Load more, then reopen (first page) while the older page is in flight
effect: A load-more answer that lands after the first page is appended to the new list and overwrites next_offset with the old cursor
fix: Fetch::Loading { request: Some(id) } and apply only the held request (connect/communities.rs:249)

title: ChatStatisticsFetch::Loading { is_dark } holds the theme but not the RequestId; the answer is filed by chat id and purpose
trigger: Open Statistics in light theme, switch to dark so refresh_chat_statistics asks again, the first answer lands second
effect: The charts are drawn with the older request's colors but recorded as the dark ones
fix: Loading { request: RequestId, is_dark } and take only that answer

title: chatInviteLinks answers for GetChatInviteLinks and GetRevokedChatInviteLinks are stored without the Loading(RequestId) check the admin pages use
trigger: Create or revoke a link while a getChatInviteLinks for the same chat is in flight
effect: The older list lands over the newer one and the panel shows the link that was just revoked
fix: apply only when the slot is Loading(pending.id), as GetAdminChatInviteLinks does (apply.rs:403)

title: chat_boost_status (level, count) and chat_boost_details hold the same answer in two maps, plus boost_level_moved as a refetch mark
trigger: getChatBoostStatus answer; updateSupergroup with a new boost_level
effect: None today; take_moved_boost_chats removes chat_boost_status but leaves chat_boost_details, and connect/groups/boosts.rs:12 drops a failed refetch (`let _`), so the details stay stale until the dialog is reopened
fix: one Fetch<BoostStatus> per chat that is marked Stale by the level change

title: CreationAsker Dialog/Closed is a two-variant flag beside NewChatStage::Creating (the real stage of the same create)
trigger: Open New Group, press Create, close the box while it is out, open another New Group
effect: Who may open/read the answer is held in the creation row (asker) while the dialog stage lives in NewChatStage; the two are kept in step by abandon_new_chat called from close/replace sites
fix: One value: the creation row exists only while the dialog owns it (Owned(request) vs Detached(request) as the stage's own variant), removed with the stage

title: PublicChatsFetch::Loading carries no RequestId; the getCreatedPublicChats answer and error are matched by purpose only
trigger: Open the public links limit box (Loading), free a link (revoke settle sets public_chats=None), reopen the box so a second list is asked while the first answer is still out
effect: The older answer lands as Loaded (or its error as Failed, apply_group_type_error writes Failed unconditionally) over the newer fetch, so the box lists stale chats or shows Failed while the newer request is in flight
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<ChatId>> with request id and answered/failed matching

title: sharing_request_answered treats any toggle service message right after the request as its answer
trigger: Two Enable Sharing requests in a chat; the first was answered by a ProtectedToggled for request A, the card of request B (older, expired) directly before it
effect: next_is_toggle only checks toggle_request_id(next).is_some(), it never compares with message_id, so an expired request card followed by any toggle keeps its Accept/Reject card instead of the expired line
fix: Compare the toggle's request_message_id with message_id for the next message too

title: Fetch errors for chat statistics, administrators, basic group members and admin rights are applied by chat id, not by the RequestId of the request that failed
trigger: A list is loaded, a refresh or membership update re-asks, the older request fails late (or a failed refresh while Loaded)
effect: GetChatStatistics, GetChatAdministrators, GetBasicGroupFullInfo and GetAdminRights errors insert Failed over a Loaded or newer Loading value (AdminListFetch/SupergroupMembersFetch/AdminRightsFetch/ChatStatisticsFetch::Loading hold no request id), so a good list is replaced by an error
fix: Move to Fetch<T> with request id (answered/failed) as invite_links and join_requests already do

title: invite_link_error and community_error are shared one-shot slots written by many purposes and overwritten by the next error
trigger: Two invite-link mutations fail before the UI poll drains the slot
effect: The first error line is lost; the slot is not tied to the request or box that caused it (also GroupsState::member_list_stale, add_members_failed)
fix: A queue of notices (like PaymentsState::notices) or the error carried in the owning box's Submit stage

title: Gift collections stale mark is cleared before the refetch is sent and lost when the send fails
trigger: Delete or change a gift collection (CollectionsFetch::Stale), then the connection refuses the getGiftCollections send in refresh_gift_collections_if_stale
effect: collections_fetch is set to Idle before fetch_gift_collections; on Err it stays Idle, the stale mark is gone, and the collection tabs keep showing the deleted/old collections until the gifts list is reopened
fix: Set Loading only after the send succeeds and leave Stale (or a Failed stage) on a failed send

title: CollectionsFetch has no Failed stage and no request id; an error settles to Idle like an answer
trigger: getGiftCollections fails on open
effect: Idle after an error is indistinguishable from never asked: no Retry, no error shown, tabs silently missing; any answer (even another owner's same-owner older one) settles Loading
fix: Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>> with request id

title: The checkout is five fields kept in step by hand: request, checkout, order_info, shipping_id, note
trigger: Buy on an invoice, Continue, close, or Buy another invoice
effect: close_checkout (checkout.rs:11), start_invoice_checkout (ui/invoice_checkout.rs:53-58, resets 4 of the 5 directly on the session) and the PaymentForm answer (apply.rs:40-43) each reset a different subset; a form fetch error leaves request Some while checkout is Closed so payments.shows() stays true
fix: One Checkout enum/struct owning invoice, form stage, order info, shipping and note, replaced whole

title: One-shot slots nothing but the UI poll clears: unlocked_notice, receipt_error, verification_url, note
trigger: Payment verification or receipt failure while the poll does not run for that window (locked/other window)
effect: verification_url written over by a second payment before the first is opened; Verifying stage has no drain of its own (doc says nothing drains it) and only a checkout close leaves it
fix: Route through PaymentsState::notices queue and give Verifying its own exit

title: Giveaway option answers are matched by chat id or purpose, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch
trigger: Open the giveaway form, change chat or reopen quickly so two getPremium/StarGiveawayOptions are out
effect: apply_star_giveaway_options and apply_giveaway_error for stars call succeed/fail_dropping_data without a request check, so an older answer overwrites the newer fetch; premium is matched only by for_chat
fix: Fetch::answered/failed with the request id

title: GiveawayLaunch::Launching holds the request as raw u64 with 0 meaning none
trigger: A launch whose request id is recorded before the send (request 0)
effect: Every match writes request != 0; same 0 sentinel in gift_market.rs (pending.map_or(0, ..) fed to waits_for(request)) so a missing pending can match a stage that holds id 0
fix: Option<RequestId>/RequestId in the variant; never pass 0 for no request

title: Earn TonStats/StarStats/AdAccountUrl answers and errors are matched by peer only; Load::Loading holds no request id
trigger: Open a revenue page, refresh (or reopen the same peer) while the first stats request is out; the older one fails
effect: apply_earn_error sets page.stars/page.ton to Failed over a Ready value from the newer request and toasts the error; an older answer overwrites a newer one
fix: Load<T> carries the request id; settle only for it

title: SendGiftState::open bool sits beside recipient/stage as the dialog's open stage
trigger: Send a gift and close or rebuild the dialog while sendGift is out
effect: apply_gift_manage_ok/error decide between the box line and a status notice from open, kept in step with recipient and stage by hand
fix: Option<SendGiftDialog> holding recipient, gifts and stage; closed is None

title: Pinned messages, poll voters and poll statistics answers and errors are applied by chat/message key, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch
trigger: Open a chat (GetPinnedMessages out), pull to the next channel and back so a second fetch is out; or open a poll's statistics twice
effect: GetPinnedMessages error calls Fetch::fail (not failed(id)) and PollVoteStatistics/PollVoters answers insert Loaded/Failed over a newer Loading, so an older answer or error replaces the newer fetch
fix: Fetch::answered/failed with the request id; PollStatsFetch/PollVotersFetch carry the request in Loading

title: SponsoredReportTarget::request is an Option used as a sent flag inside SponsoredReportFlow::Asking
trigger: Report an ad: Asking with request None until the send leaves
effect: Asking(request None) means not sent, Asking(Some) means out; a failed send relies on dismiss() being called by the caller to leave; the error arm compares target.request == Some(id) only
fix: Choosing(target) and Asking(target, RequestId) as separate variants

title: BotLookup holds three Options (exact: Option<Option<i64>>, mine, global) as per-leg arrived flags; done() is all three Some
trigger: Type a chatbot username on the Business chatbots screen
effect: Each leg's stage is None/Some; a failed leg is recorded as Some(empty) (apply_business_extra_error) so a refused search reads as an answered empty result and the box says no results instead of an error
fix: A Leg enum per part (Asking(request), Found(..), Failed) like SearchState's Leg

title: scope_settings_loading HashSet is a loading flag by scope kept in step by hand with scope_notification_settings and the request registry
trigger: Open Notifications settings while getScopeNotificationSettings fails or an update lands first
effect: The set is inserted in connect, removed in apply (answer), apply_error, send failure and UpdateScopeNotificationSettings; a failed fetch leaves neither Failed nor data, so the defaults silently read as unknown and nothing shows an error
fix: HashMap<Scope, Fetch<ScopeNotificationSettings>>

title: Sessions, connected websites, storage statistics, account TTL, default auto-delete and saved sounds answers and errors are matched by purpose only, not by the request id Fetch::Loading can hold
trigger: Press Refresh twice, or refetch after a terminate while an earlier getActiveSessions is still out
effect: The older answer succeed()s or the older error fail()s over the newer fetch (apply_settings_error GetActiveSessions/GetConnectedWebsites/GetStorageStatistics/GetAccountTtl call fail without a request check)
fix: Fetch::answered(id)/failed(id) at each site

title: BusinessSettingsState::saving is a Vec of setting kinds cleared by kind, not by request id; error is one shared slot
trigger: Save the same Business setting twice quickly (second send while the first is out)
effect: The first answer or error removes the kind while the second request is still out, so the screen re-enables the control early; the shared error slot is also written by chat links, chatbot and ads failures (business_extra.rs:258)
fix: saving: Vec<(kind, RequestId)> removed by id; per-screen errors

title: sending and changing are shadow copies of the request registry, pruned lazily at the next send
trigger: A quick reply send or change whose request is lost (logout sweep, dropped continuation)
effect: Entries stay until the next send_quick_reply_request retains by registry; the answer and error arms never remove them, so the maps are correct only after the next call prunes them
fix: Ask the registry (has_purpose with the key) instead of mirroring it, or remove on answer/error

title: A failed setOption(language_pack_id) or synchronizeLanguagePack is swallowed
trigger: Switch the interface language while TDLib refuses the setOption or the synchronize
effect: apply_language_error ignores SetOption and Synchronize: the strings fetch can still install the pack in the UI while TDLib keeps the old language option, and no SwitchFailed event is queued
fix: Make SetOption and Synchronize part of the switch stage (a request id in Fetching) so their error leaves it with SwitchFailed

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention
trigger: A notification-worthy message arrives while the notifier does not run (locked, logged out, other window)
effect: The one-shot bool is set by the reducer (session_apply_messages.rs:479) and drained only by notify_accounts.rs:225 take; allowed with a reason in implicit-state-allow.txt and still in the baseline (four lines), so the register keeps it
fix: A queued AttentionEvent drained by the notifier, or remove from the baseline lines (duplicate entries) once the allow entry stands

title: data_storage_dirty is a reducer-written, driver-cleared persist flag; auto_download_answer is a one-shot slot
trigger: The presets answer seeds data_storage; the driver persists on the next ingest; two saves answer before the UI takes the slot
effect: data_storage_dirty stays set if the driver never ingests (locked/hidden) or the write fails; auto_download_answer holds only the newest answer so an earlier editor misses its Saved/Refused
fix: A persist command queue, and a per-request answer map consumed by the editor that sent it

title: tray_refresh mark is drained by upkeep and lost when the getChatActiveStories send fails
trigger: Post a story from another client while offline/send refused; frame_upkeep drains tray_refresh then `let _ = get_chat_active_stories(..)`
effect: The own story never appears in the tray until some unrelated update refreshes that chat
fix: keep the mark until the send succeeds (re-insert on Err) or model the poster's tray as Fetch with Outdated

title: A failed GetBursts goes back to Unasked, so it is re-sent on every ingest of the live story call
trigger: Watch a live story while getCustomEmojiReactionAnimations keeps failing (flood, offline server error); maybe_fetch_live_bursts runs from ingest on each group call update
effect: Request loop at the group-call update rate; never reaches a Failed stage
fix: LiveBursts::Failed (asked once per session, like Fetch) and hold the RequestId in Requested

title: LiveBursts::Requested holds no RequestId; the stickers answer is matched by purpose only
trigger: set_live_bursts(stickers) runs for any GetBursts answer; a second GetBursts (after the error reset to Unasked) can be answered out of order
effect: An older answer lands on a newer request or after a reset
fix: Requested(RequestId) matched in set_live_bursts / apply_live_story_error, or Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>>

title: StoryAvailableReactions answer with any other purpose (or none) is stored into the story picker's available_reactions
trigger: A StoryAvailableReactions payload that is not GetMessageAvailableReactions arrives (stale or update-like); else-branch writes it
effect: Picker options replaced by an answer that was not asked for the story; options are also not keyed by story
fix: gate the else-branch on RequestPurpose::GetStoryAvailableReactions and hold it as Fetch<Vec<..>> with a RequestId

title: getCloseFriends answer sets Ready without matching the RequestId held in CloseFriendsList::Loading (section 8 05-166 skip says the load is matched; only the failure is)
trigger: Open close friends (getCloseFriends in flight), save a new list (setCloseFriends ok sets Ready(ids)), then the older getCloseFriends answer lands
effect: The just-saved close friends list is overwritten by the older server list until reopened
fix: CloseFriendsList::answered(request, ids) that only takes the answer of the Loading request, as fail_load does for the error

title: Contacts invalidation resets Fetch to Idle by hand at six sites instead of Fetch::outdate
trigger: Add/remove/import/clear contacts (users/apply.rs 261, 278; session_apply_ok.rs 784, 791, 825, 829)
effect: The list blanks under a spinner, an in-flight getContacts stays in requests (has_purpose blocks the refetch until its answer is dropped), the 'refetch owed' is implied by Idle
fix: self.users_state.contacts.outdate() (Fetch::Outdated) at every site, one refetch owner

title: active_reactions and active_emoji_reactions are two copies of updateActiveEmojiReactions written together
trigger: apply.rs:23-24 writes both; ui/reactions.rs reads one, session_group_admin.rs the other
effect: None today; a writer that updates one copy leaves the other stale
fix: one field

title: Stale-mark bools (reaction_options_stale, creator_refetch_sets, StickerPanel recent/favorites/trending_stale, GifPanel::stale) are hand-cleared refetch stages beside their Fetch lists
trigger: set by updates, cleared by connect/stickers.rs and sticker_creator.rs after the send
effect: None today; each owner clears its own bool, a new reader must know the order (send, then clear)
fix: Fetch::Outdated per list (outdate() on update, wants_fetch() in the driver)

title: reaction_options_stale refetch resets message_reaction_options to Idle before fetch_message_reactions; a refused send leaves the picker Idle with the stale mark then cleared next poll (target() is None)
trigger: updateActiveEmojiReactions while a reaction picker is open and the send is refused (offline)
effect: Open picker never gets its options until closed and reopened
fix: keep MessageReactionsState::Loading/Outdated through the send and fail it on Err

title: Attached Stickers box: attached_request + attached_answer + sticker_set_view(loading 0) are three fields moved in step by connect/stickers.rs
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets sets all three; apply/error clear two of them
effect: None today; a one-shot answer slot is read by open_attached_sticker_set with take()
fix: one enum AttachedSets { Idle, Asked(RequestId), Answered(Option<i64>) } or put the stage into StickerSetViewStage

title: archived_has_more and archived_next_offset change together beside the archived Fetch; finish_mask_mutation resets all three by hand
trigger: accept_archived_mask_sets writes has_more+offset then succeed; finish_mask_mutation clears them separately
effect: None today
fix: one ArchivedMasks paging value inside the Fetch data

title: getForumTopics answer is matched by purpose and chat id, not by a RequestId; CreateForumTopic removes the list while an older request is in flight
trigger: Chat list asks a forum's topics, user creates a topic (list removed), the older getForumTopics answer lands
effect: Stale topic list without the new topic is inserted as Ready; the chat list never asks again
fix: Fetch::sent(request) in ForumTopicsMap::begin and answered(request, ..); CreateForumTopic uses outdate()

title: SaveWatch::take_outcome takes a caller-supplied in_flight bool beside SaveAnswer::Waiting (two sources of truth for 'still in flight': the watch and requests.pending)
trigger: A watched profile request is dropped without an answer; the caller must pass in_flight=false from requests.pending to get Unknown
effect: A caller that passes the wrong in_flight keeps a box in Saving or claims Saved; no stage of the box holds the request

trigger: Start screen share, cancel_start, start again; the first request's answer arrives during the second Starting
effect: The first presentation answer is connected for the second start
fix: Starting { request: RequestId, answer }

title: Fetch::succeed / fail ignore the RequestId; many owners (sticker lists, emoji icon lists, live story extras, greeting stickers) take answers by purpose only
trigger: apply.rs stickers `list.succeed(())`, apply_stickers_error `list.fail(..)`, stories/live.rs streamer/donors/senders
effect: A late answer of an older request after outdate()/begin() lands on the newer ask

trigger: advance_manager_commit sets front.sent = Some(id), answers do not clear it
effect: None today; note_commit_failure matches the old id only, but a step taken off by next_step on a failed send leaves failure set until the UI clears it (note_send_failure is also called twice per failure)
fix: CommitStage { Idle, Sent(RequestId) , Failed } on ManagerCommit

title: Hand-rolled fetch enums with a bare Loading (PollStatsFetch, InviteLinkCountsFetch, AdminRightsFetch, AdminListFetch, SupergroupMembersFetch, PollVotersFetch, InlineQueryFetch, ChatEventLogFetch, ChatStatisticsFetch) take answers by chat/message key, not RequestId

effect: The older answer lands on the newer ask; each enum is a copy of Fetch<T> without the request id
fix:
Fetch / Paged

with the RequestId in Loading, matched in the answer and error arms

title: EventLog keeps ChatEventLogFetch::Loading (no id) beside EventLogWait { page, poll } request ids: 'loading' and 'which request' are two fields changed together
trigger: A refresh forgets both waits and sets fetch to Idle; a page and a poll answer are matched by wait ids
effect: None today; a writer that changes one and not the other leaves Loading with no request, or a wait with no Loading
fix: EventLogFetch::Loading { page: RequestId } with the poll id in Loaded

title: Ownership box stages hold no RequestId: check is Fetch::Loading{request: None} set by hand and Ready(result) set by accept, OwnerLookup::Loading and TransferStage::Sending carry none
trigger: canTransferOwnership asked twice (dialog reopened), or getChatOwnerAfterLeaving for the same chat asked again
effect: An older answer or error lands on the newer ask; fail_ownership_transfer overwrites any stage, also Idle or Done
fix: Fetch::sent(request) + answered(request, ..); OwnerLookup::Loading(RequestId); TransferStage::Sending { request, transfer }

title: Rollback of an overlapping privacy save restores `previous` over a newer save
trigger: Set the inactive-session timeout to 30 (previous 180), then to 60 (previous 30) before the first answers; the first request fails (flood, offline)
effect: The row snaps back to 180 while the second save succeeded on the server (60); the screen is wrong until the page is reopened. Same for SetNewChatPrivacy
fix: Hold the in-flight save as a stage with its RequestId (like scope_saves/reaction_saves) and roll back only when the failing request is the newest, or compare `shown` as RequestRollback does

title: `inactive_session_ttl_days: Option` is the loading flag; a refused save with previous None restores None = loading forever
trigger: Open privacy while the first getActiveSessions is unanswered, set the timeout, the save is refused
effect: The timeout row reads as still loading and nothing refetches it (the code comment says so)
fix: Fetch<i32> for the timeout so loading, ready and failed are variants and a failed save restores Ready(previous) or leaves Failed with a retry

title: ChatSearchState keeps `chat_id: Option` beside `status == Closed` and resets sender/media/from_picker by hand in open_for and close
trigger: Open in-chat search, pick a sender and media tab, close, reopen for another chat
effect: No bug today; open/closed lives in two fields (chat_id and status) changed together in open_for/close, and the filter fields are cleared at two call sites
fix: enum ChatSearchSurface { Closed, Open(OpenChatSearch { chat_id, query, criteria, results, paging, jump }) } replaced whole on open/close

title: clear_query keeps `confirm` (PaidPostSearch) while the results and generation reset
trigger: Free public-post searches run out, the Stars confirm row shows for query X, the user clears the field
effect: The inline confirm row for the old query can stay over the Recents surface (accepting is guarded by query, so it only misleads)
fix: Fold `confirm` into the search stage (or reset it in clear_results) so a new generation drops it

title: SavedPage { Idle, Asking(RequestId) } sits beside TopicHistory::older/OlderEnd, the real paging stage of the same history
trigger: Open a Saved sublist, scroll to load an older page, the page fails
effect: Page-in-flight lives in `page` while Failed/Complete live in `history.older`; they are reset separately (session_saved.rs:198-260) and can disagree
fix: Put the request into the older end (OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId)) and delete SavedPage

title: Inline query answer is matched by (chat, bot, first_page) against `InlineQueryFetch::Loading`, not by the RequestId
trigger: Type `@bot cat`, then change to `@bot dog` while the first request is out (inline_query returns Ok(None) while one is in flight, so the slot keeps query `cat`)
effect: The cat page lands in the slot as the answer to the current query, or the dog query is never sent until the next keystroke
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading(RequestId) and accept only the answer whose id is held; re-send when the typed query differs from the slot's

title: A late voters page becomes the whole list after updatePoll dropped the cached pages
trigger: Open the voters dialog, press Load more, an updatePoll arrives (apply_update_poll retains the cached pages away), then the page answers
effect: offset>0 with no Loaded entry falls through to `_ => voters`: the dialog shows only voters 51-100 as the full list with a wrong total
fix: PollVotersFetch::Loading(RequestId) / Paging(RequestId); drop an answer whose id is not the one held

title: Venue bot lookup answered by purpose only; VenueBot::Resolving holds no RequestId
trigger: Change the venue bot username (set_venue_bot_username resets to Unknown) while a ResolveVenueBot request is in flight
effect: The old username's answer lands as Found/Missing for the new username
fix: VenueBot::Resolving(RequestId); venue_bot_resolved takes the pending id and ignores any other

title: Ping slot is PingStatus::Checking in proxy.pings plus the RequestId in settings.proxy_ping_requests, kept in step by hand
trigger: Ping a proxy, edit it (slot cleared) and ping again
effect: No bug today; take_awaited_ping has to check both maps and every writer has to update both
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) and delete proxy_ping_requests

title: One `proxy.error: Option<String>` beside three stages (fetch, mutation, IPv6 save) and the system step
trigger: Load of the proxy list fails, then an unrelated background fetch succeeds
effect: The load error stays until a mutation succeeds or the user refreshes; each stage clears the line only in some paths
fix: Put the error in each stage (ProxyFetch::Failed(String), ProxyMutation::Failed(String)) and derive the line

title: MentionSearch::request and FromPicker::request are `Option<RequestId>` meaning in flight, with the results beside them
trigger: Type `@` in a group, then a refused or lost searchChatMembers
effect: No bug today (fail_mention_search and the search error path clear them); loading and loaded-empty differ only by an Option
fix: Fetch-like enum { Asking(RequestId), Ready(Vec<..>), Failed } per search

title: forget_screen_outcomes does not clear users_state.contacts_notice
trigger: Import or delete contacts in an account, switch away before the answer, switch back
effect: The account comes back showing an old 'Contacts imported.' / 'Contact deleted.' line as news
fix: Drain contacts_notice through the same one-shot list, or key it to the screen that asked

title: ReplyTarget::Retry never gives up: any error other than 400/404 (403, 500) is asked again every 10 seconds
trigger: Open a chat with a reply to a message TDLib answers with 403 (no access)
effect: getRepliedMessage is re-sent from upkeep every 10 s for as long as the chat is shown
fix: ReplyTarget::Retry { until, attempts } with a cap, then Missing

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention (bool, one-shot dock bounce)
trigger: A notifying message arrives with flash_bounce on
effect: No bug: drain_on_screen takes it. Listed in the baseline and allow list
fix: Fold into the notification drain (NotifyDrain event queued with the notification) so no bool is kept

title: baseline: ActiveGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (TDLib mirror)
trigger: Join a group call with many participants
effect: No bug: mirrors groupCall.loaded_all_participants; allow-listed as independent
fix: Keep as is, or ParticipantsLoad::{Partial, All} when touched

title: restore_optimistic ends in `_ => {}` and apply_error lists the same variants again; ChatPermissions, ChatPinOrder and ArchiveChatListSettings are handled in a second place
trigger: Add a new RequestRollback variant
effect: The compiler does not force a rollback arm, so a refused change can stay on screen
fix: One exhaustive match (move the three arms into restore_optimistic) and delete the wildcard

title: PendingBotMessage keeps `can_stop: bool` beside `stop: BotStopStage` and finish_pending_bot_stop sets both by hand
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming draft that has keep_on_stop
effect: No bug today; Stopped implies can_stop=false is written in one place (session_apply_messages.rs:585)
fix: Make BotStopStage carry can-stop (Running { can_stop }, Stopped) so one value changes

title: check_password_suggested mirrors the 'suggestedActionCheckPassword' entry of chat_list.suggestions
trigger: The server removes the suggested action while a hideSuggestedAction fails
effect: Two copies of one fact updated in apply_privacy_data_payload and apply_privacy_data_ok; HideSuggestedAction's error re-adds only the list copy
fix: Derive the bool from suggestions (has_action(CHECK)) and delete the field

title: apply_local_search_filter writes surface and generation by hand, bypassing begin_query/bump_generation
trigger: Screenshot demo or offline path types in global search with a debounced query pending
effect: The typed Debounce stays armed and confirm/top_view are not reset, because only SearchState's own transitions cancel them
fix: Call begin_query/begin_recents and then accept_* so the stage resets in its own transitions
